The evanescent Bloch waves available at each frequency are matched directly to force balance at a free end or a domain wall, without transfer matrices, which yields closed-form frequencies and decay lengths for every localized mode. The free-end mode sits at a branch point of the complex band structure, where the acoustic and optical sheets join and the decay is fastest. For uniform springs, a sharp wall between the two mass orderings hosts one in-gap mode, symmetric at the light$\mid$light wall and antisymmetric at the heavy$\mid$heavy wall, and an adiabatic construction shows that these are the same topological mode; the light$\mid$light wall also binds a non-topological mode above the optical branch. Spectral unfolding makes this classification visible in momentum space: the sign of the Bloch factor sets the zone-center or zone-boundary character of each mode, and its magnitude sets the width. The Zak phase, quantized by inversion, identifies the modes of topological origin and fixes a half-integer mode count per band at a wall, while the chiral symmetry known to be hidden in strain coordinates explains which frequencies are pinned.

AI.tldr: 本文用复能带理论对交替质量一维链（SSH型力学模型）的局域振动给出全解析描述：直接用渐逝Bloch波满足自由端/畴壁力平衡条件，无需转移矩阵，得到所有局域模的闭式频率与衰减长度。
AI.motivation: 交替质量一维链是最简单的具有拓扑能带的力学系统，但其局域振动（自由端模、畴壁模）通常依赖转移矩阵等数值手段，缺乏统一、透明的解析图像，尤其复能带视角下的分类与拓扑判据尚不清晰。
AI.method: 1）基于复能带结构，把每个频率可用的渐逝Bloch波直接与自由端或畴壁处的力平衡条件匹配，避免转移矩阵，得到闭式频率和衰减长度；2）分析自由端模所处的复能带分支点（声学支与光学支汇合、衰减最快处）；3）用绝热构造证明均匀弹簧下轻|轻壁对称模与重|重壁反对称模为同一拓扑模；4）用谱展开（Bloch因子符号/幅值）在动量空间刻画区心/区界属性与模宽；5）用Zak相位（受反演对称量子化）和隐藏于应变坐标的手征对称性判定拓扑起源、每个能带的半整数模数计数及被钉扎频率。
AI.result: 自由端模位于复能带分支点，衰减最快；均匀弹簧时，两种质量排序间锐利畴壁各承载一个带隙内模——轻|轻壁为对称、重|重壁为反对称，绝热构造表明二者是同一个拓扑模；轻|轻壁还额外束缚一个位于光学支上方的非拓扑模。Zak相位（反演量子化）识别拓扑模来源，并确定畴壁处每条能带的半整数模式计数；手征对称性解释了哪些频率被钉扎。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为交替质量一维链的局域振动提供完整解析框架，统一了自由端模与畴壁模的复能带描述、动量空间分类及拓扑判据，可作为力学拓扑系统解析分析的范例。

title: Fundamental Bounds on the Oscillation Efficiency of Markov Networks
summary: Stochastic oscillations are commonly identified through peaks in their power spectra, yet the fundamental limits on their strength and energetic cost remain unclear. Here we establish universal dynamical and thermodynamic bounds on oscillation efficiency in Markov networks, showing how finite state spaces constrain spectral peak enhancement. In particular, we demonstrate that networks maximizing modal coherence need not maximize oscillation efficiency. We further derive dissipation bounds that connect oscillation efficiency to the relaxation speed and stationary probabilities, revealing an unavoidable energetic cost of maintaining pronounced oscillations at a specified relaxation timescale. These bounds remain strictly positive in regimes where existing explicit spectral dissipation estimates vanish, with stronger constraints for normal networks and uniform rings. Our results distinguish spectral oscillatory strength from modal coherence and reveal how network dynamics and thermodynamic dissipation jointly limit stochastic oscillations.

AI.tldr: 该文为马尔可夫网络中的随机振荡建立了普适的动力学与热力学界限，揭示有限状态空间对谱峰增强的限制，并推导出将振荡效率与弛豫速度和稳态概率关联的耗散界限。
AI.motivation: 随机振荡通常通过功率谱中的峰值来识别，但其强度和能量代价的根本极限尚不清楚，需要厘清谱振荡强度、模态相干性与热力学耗散之间的关系。
AI.method: 在马尔可夫网络框架下，建立关于振荡效率的普适动力学界限与热力学（耗散）界限，并针对正规网络与均匀环等特殊情形给出更强的约束分析。
AI.result: 证明有限状态空间约束谱峰增强；最大化模态相干性的网络未必最大化振荡效率；所推导的耗散界限在已有显式谱耗散估计为零的区域仍严格为正。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了谱振荡强度与模态相干性，并表明网络动力学与热力学耗散共同限制随机振荡，为振荡效率与能量代价提供了统一界限。

title: Kinematics of Inverse Compton Scattering from Dirac Carriers in Graphene
summary: We examine the kinematics of Compton and inverse Compton scattering by Dirac carriers in graphene. Unlike photons in vacuum, which propagate at the speed of light c, graphene carriers have a characteristic velocity vF, with vF much less than c. This difference means that the standard Compton scattering formula cannot be applied to graphene simply by replacing c with vF. We first examine Compton-like scattering for a gapless Dirac carrier initially at the Dirac point and for a gapped carrier at the band edge, both corresponding to zero in-plane momentum. We then consider scattering from an energetic gapless Dirac carrier. By combining energy conservation with the graphene dispersion and in-plane momentum conservation, we obtain a quadratic equation for the scattered photon energy within the model considered. This relation is the main kinematic result of the work. We identify inverse Compton-like scattering by the transfer of energy from the carrier to the photon, subject to the simultaneous conservation of energy and in-plane momentum. We also discuss how this process differs kinematically from Doppler-shifted emission, Cerenkov-like radiation, harmonic generation, photon drag, and other nonlinear optical processes. Finally, we propose a time-resolved pump-probe arrangement in which the scattered photon spectrum is the primary observable, while time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (TR-ARPES) provides an independent probe of the nonequilibrium carrier distribution. These results provide a kinematic framework for analysing inverse Compton-like scattering in graphene and for identifying the conditions under which energy can be transferred from energetic Dirac carriers to photons.

AI.tldr: 本文研究石墨烯中狄拉克载流子参与的康普顿与逆康普顿散射运动学，指出不能简单把真空光速c替换为费米速度vF，给出散射光子能量的二次方程及逆康普顿散射条件，并提出泵浦-探测实验方案。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯载流子以费米速度vF（远小于c）传播，与真空光子不同，因此标准康普顿散射公式无法通过简单替换c→vF套用，需要建立适用于石墨烯的运动学框架。
AI.method: 结合能量守恒、石墨烯色散关系与面内动量守恒，分别处理位于狄拉克点（无能隙）、能带边缘（有能隙，面内动量为零）及高能无能隙狄拉克载流子的康普顿类散射，推导散射光子能量的二次方程；并分析能量由载流子转移至光子的逆康普顿类过程。
AI.result: 得到散射光子能量的二次方程作为核心运动学结果；识别出满足能量与面内动量同时守恒的逆康普顿类散射；并阐明其与多普勒频移发射、切伦科夫类辐射、谐波产生、光子拖曳等非线性光学过程的运动学差异。
AI.conclusion: 建立了分析石墨烯中逆康普顿类散射的运动学框架，明确了能量从高能狄拉克载流子转移到光子的条件，并提出以散射光子谱为主要观测量、TR-ARPES独立探测非平衡载流子分布的时间分辨泵浦-探测方案。

title: Termination-dependent surface Fermiology in the intercalated altermagnet CoNb$_4$Se$_8$
summary: Altermagnets have recently gained attention for hosting symmetry-enforced spin-split bands despite zero net magnetization. Angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy (ARPES) offers direct access to their electronic structure. However, the intrinsic surface sensitivity of this technique complicates the identification of the observed features: Surface states can be misinterpreted as the spin-split counterpart of bulk bands. This issue becomes particularly relevant for layered intercalated systems, where micrometer-sized domains with distinct terminations often coexist on a cleaved surface. We discuss this scenario for CoNb$_4$Se$_8$, one of the first established layered altermagnets. Supported by density functional theory calculations, we employ micro-ARPES to probe individual domains and reveal two contrasting surface terminations. We identify Co- and Se-terminated domains with characteristic surface states arising from bulk-surface connectivity of the material. Our work shows that termination-dependent surface contributions are essential for the reliable spectroscopic identification of altermagnetism and for assessing its presence across the family of layered materials.

AI.tldr: 该文研究层状交错磁体CoNb4Se8，用微区ARPES结合DFT揭示解理面存在Co终止与Se终止两类畴，其表面态源于体-表面连接，提醒表面态可能被误判为体带的自旋劈裂，强调识别交错磁性须重视终止依赖的表面贡献。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体虽零净磁化却具有对称性导致的自旋劈裂能带，ARPES可直接探测其电子结构；但ARPES固有的表面敏感性使表面态易被误认为体带的自旋劈裂对应物，尤其对解理面上微米级不同终止畴共存的层状插层体系（如CoNb4Se8），这一混淆风险突出。
AI.method: 以层状交错磁体CoNb4Se8为对象，采用微区ARPES对解理面单个微米畴分别测量，并辅以密度泛函理论计算进行对照。
AI.result: 微区ARPES结合DFT揭示存在两类对比鲜明的表面终止——Co终止畴和Se终止畴，各自具有源于材料体-表面连接的特征表面态。
AI.conclusion: 终止依赖的表面贡献对于可靠地用谱学方法识别交错磁性至关重要，也是在层状材料家族中评估交错磁性是否存在时必须考虑的因素。

title: Hydrogen Ion-Cut Single-Crystal Diamond Membranes for Wide and Ultrawide Bandgap Semiconductor Heterointegration
summary: Single-crystal diamond membranes (SCDms) were created using a hydrogen ion-cut process combined with a two-step post-implantation annealing, electrochemical etching, and micro-transfer printing. Monte Carlo simulations comparing H, He, C, and O implantation predicted a narrower vacancy-distribution profile for hydrogen under the implantation conditions examined. Raman spectroscopy was used to evaluate implantation-induced lattice damage and its recovery during annealing and membrane release, while optical bandgap analysis provided further evidence of restoration of the diamond lattice structure. After delamination and removal of residual graphitic material, freestanding SCDms with improved crystalline quality were obtained. The SCDms were subsequently transferred to GaN, SiC, AlGaN, and AlN substrates without an adhesive layer. The successful formation of diamond/WBG and diamond/UWBG heterostructures demonstrates the feasibility of integrating the SCDms with a range of semiconductor platforms. Overall, these results establish hydrogen implantation as an effective route for producing high-quality SCDms for future diamond-based heterogeneous integration applications.

AI.tldr: 通过氢离子注入剥离、两步退火、电化学刻蚀和微转移印刷制备高质量单晶金刚石薄膜，并粘附层无地转移至GaN、SiC、AlGaN、AlN上，实现金刚石与宽/超宽禁带半导体异质集成。
AI.motivation: 金刚石具有优异特性，需与GaN、SiC、AlN等宽禁带半导体平台异质集成，但缺乏高质量单晶金刚石薄膜（SCDm）的可控制备与无损转移方法。
AI.method: 采用氢离子剥离工艺结合两步注入后退火、电化学刻蚀与微转移印刷；用蒙特卡洛模拟比较H、He、C、O注入的空位分布；用拉曼光谱和光学带隙分析评估晶格损伤及恢复。
AI.result: 模拟显示在所考察条件下氢注入的空位分布更窄；退火与膜释放后晶格结构得到恢复，去除残余石墨后获得高质量自支撑SCDm；无需粘附层成功转移至GaN、SiC、AlGaN和AlN，形成金刚石/宽禁带与超宽禁带异质结构。
AI.conclusion: 氢注入是制备高质量单晶金刚石薄膜的有效途径，为未来金刚石基异质集成应用奠定基础。

title: Magnetic Field-assisted Crystallographic Selection During Grain Growth in Non-Magnetic Polycrystals: A Phase-Field Study
summary: Magnetic fields drive grain boundary migration in non-magnetic systems through anisotropic susceptibility, yet how the local orientation can affect the resulting collective grain growth behavior remains unclear. We employ a phase-field model to investigate magnetic-field-assisted grain growth in the diamagnetic Bi. This study provides a mechanistic basis for using static and dynamically varied magnetic fields to control texture development and grain growth kinetics in weakly magnetic materials. We also identify the conditions under which magnetic-field-driven orientation selection produces a distinct bimodal grain-size distribution. The bicrystal studies establish that boundary migration is governed by the magnetic free-energy difference between differently oriented grains, while polycrystalline field-sweep simulations reveal a transition from capillary-dominated coarsening to magnetically biased texture selection. For unbiased orientation distributions, magnetic selection remains distributed; however, when a small population of grains is strongly favored, the driving force localizes and exhibits bimodal coarsening characterized by enlarged favored grains embedded within a fine-grained matrix, even without grain boundary energy anisotropy, particle pinning, or heterogeneity. The field removal and field reorientation simulations further show that magnetic field history can redirect the coarsening pathway.

AI.tldr: 该文用相场模型研究磁场如何通过各向异性磁化率驱动非磁性体系（弱磁性的铋 Bi）的晶界迁移与集体晶粒长大，揭示从毛细驱动粗化到磁场偏置织构选择的转变，并识别出磁场诱导双峰晶粒尺寸分布的条件。
AI.motivation: 磁场可通过各向异性磁化率驱动非磁性系统的晶界迁移，但局域取向如何影响由此产生的集体晶粒长大行为仍不清楚；同时希望为利用静态与动态磁场调控弱磁性材料的织构与晶粒长大动力学提供机理依据。
AI.method: 采用相场（phase-field）模型模拟磁场辅助的晶粒长大，研究对象为抗磁性铋（Bi）。包括双晶（bicrystal）研究以确定晶界迁移由不同取向晶粒间的磁自由能差控制，以及多晶"磁场扫描"模拟考察织构演化；并开展移除磁场与磁场重取向（reorientation）的模拟。
AI.result: 双晶模拟表明晶界迁移受不同取向晶粒间磁自由能差支配；多晶模拟显示由毛细驱动粗化向磁场偏置的织构选择发生转变。对于无偏取向分布，磁选择保持"分布式"；但当小部分晶粒被强烈偏好时，驱动力局域化，出现双峰粗化——被偏好晶粒长大并嵌入细晶基体中，且无需晶界能各向异性、颗粒钉扎或异质性。磁场移除与重取向模拟表明磁场历史可改变粗化路径。
AI.conclusion: 局域取向通过晶粒间磁自由能差控制晶界迁移，并决定磁场辅助晶粒长大是分布式选择还是局域化的双峰粗化；静态与动态磁场可用来调控弱磁性材料的织构发展与长大动力学，且磁场历史（移除、重取向）可重定向粗化路径，为磁场调控微观组织提供机理基础。

title: topas-editor and TOPilot: tools for AI-driven analysis of diffraction and total scattering data
comment: submitted to Journal of Applied Crystallography
summary: This paper describes topas-editor and TOPilot, which provide a powerful interface to the TOPAS software suite and allow generative AI-driven automation of complex crystallographic tasks. topas-editor is a TOPAS-aware VS Code extension designed for the rapid creation and editing of TOPAS input files and for interacting with the software. It knows TOPAS syntax, has crystallographic-aware editing features and provides in-line user guidance via hover tips and automated links to reference manuals. TOPilot is a collection of Python routines and machine-accessible reference documents that allow AI-driven automated analysis in TOPAS. It uses a transferable topas-inp-writer skill that can be applied in all TOPAS application areas. We demonstrate the power and reliability of the approach using examples including: a complex Rietveld refinement with sample- and data-related complications; automatic analysis of multiple data sets; a pipeline from indexing through structure solution to refinement; automatic identification of the phases present in a sample; single crystal and powder diffraction analysis of incommensurate structures; and fitting PDF data. TOPilot can be used directly alongside topas-editor, via a stand-alone topilot-wizard, or via command line interfaces or desktop apps from major AI providers. TOPilot was developed and tested using Claude large language models, but can be configured to use other cloud or local models. topas-editor and TOPilot are freely available.

AI.tldr: 论文介绍 topas-editor 与 TOPilot：前者是感知 TOPAS 语法的 VS Code 扩展，用于快速编写/编辑与交互；后者是一组 Python 例程加机器可读参考文档，通过可迁移的 topas-inp-writer 技能让生成式 AI 自动完成复杂晶体学分析任务。
AI.motivation: TOPAS 软件功能强大但使用门槛高，复杂晶体学任务（Rietveld 精修、结构解析、多数据集分析等）需要大量专业知识与人工操作，作者希望用生成式 AI 实现这些任务的自动化，并降低编辑输入的难度。
AI.method: 开发 TOPAS 感知的 VS Code 扩展 topas-editor，具备语法与晶体学感知的编辑功能和悬浮提示、手册链接等指导；构建 TOPilot，包含 Python 例程和机器可访问的参考文档，采用可跨应用领域复用的 topas-inp-writer 技能；可通过编辑器、独立 topilot-wizard、命令行或主流 AI 提供商桌面应用调用，基于 Claude 大模型开发测试，也可配置云端或本地模型。
AI.result: 在多种场景中验证了可靠性与能力：含样品与数据问题的复杂 Rietveld 精修、多数据集自动分析、从指标化到结构解析再到精修的流水线、物相自动识别、单晶与粉末的非公度结构分析、PDF 数据拟合。
AI.conclusion: topas-editor 与 TOPilot 为 TOPAS 提供了强大的 AI 驱动自动化接口，可有效处理复杂晶体学工作流，且免费开放、支持多种模型与调用方式。

title: pymatgen: 15 years of community growth, new functionality, and future prospects
summary: We present a retrospective on the Python Materials Genomics (pymatgen) library, reflecting on 15 years of community growth and established best practices. The current version of pymatgen builds on its robust, open-source foundation, emphasising its collaborative nature. Over the past decade, pymatgen has thrived as one of the largest open-source materials science codebases. We detail how pymatgen supports advanced computational materials science workflows, how it adapts to changing demands, and the lessons learned from its growing community, providing guidance beyond pymatgen's open-source community. Pymatgen will continue to evolve in response to the current rapidly changing landscape of computational materials science and materials informatics. We discuss the challenges and potential solutions to managing the community-driven evolution of pymatgen and provide an outlook on its future development.

AI.tldr: 回顾 pymatgen 库 15 年开源社区发展，总结其支撑材料计算工作流的经验、挑战与未来展望。
AI.motivation: pymatgen 已成为最大的材料科学开源代码库之一，需系统总结其社区驱动演进的经验与教训，为其他开源科研软件提供参考。
AI.method: 以回顾性综述形式，梳理 15 年社区成长历程、开源协作基础、对先进计算材料科学工作流的支撑方式及对需求变化的适应机制。
AI.result: 总结了 pymatgen 保障先进计算材料科学工作流的能力、随需求演进的最佳实践，以及社区增长中积累的经验与指导性建议。
AI.conclusion: pymatgen 将持续响应计算材料科学与材料信息学的快速变化，并探讨了社区驱动演进的管理挑战与解决方案及未来发展方向。

title: Linear response for machine-learned interatomic potentials: phonons at arbitrary wave vectors from the primitive cell
summary: Phonon calculations with machine-learned interatomic potentials are almost exclusively performed with finite displacements in supercells, an approach that is exact only at wave vectors commensurate with the supercell and whose error depends on the range of the force constants. In message-passing networks this range grows with the number of layers, and reaches 140 angstrom for the deepest universal models. Here we show that the dynamical matrix of a message-passing potential can be obtained exactly in the primitive cell, at any wave vector, as the linear response of the forces to a displacement modulated by a Bloch phase, in the spirit of density-functional perturbation theory. The phase enters only where the features of neighboring atoms are gathered, and the trained model is used without modification. One further derivative yields group velocities and mode Grüneisen parameters analytically. We apply the method to NequIP and Prophet, and reproduce the Hessians of supercells to machine precision. Using these results as a reference, we find that the supercells commonly employed in high-throughput calculations lead to errors of several tenths of a THz in the phonon frequencies, and that these errors decrease slowly with the size of the supercell, in particular for deep models. For a low-symmetry silicate, the supercell predicts a dynamical instability that the model does not have. Quantities that depend on derivatives of the dispersion, such as the group velocities and the Grüneisen parameter at low temperature, are considerably more affected than the frequencies themselves. When both approaches are used to obtain the same force constants, their computational cost is comparable for crystals with symmetry.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种在原胞内、任意波矢下精确求解消息传递势动力学矩阵的方法（对力做Bloch相位调制位移的线性响应，类似DFPT），避免超胞有限位移误差，并解析给出群速度与Grüneisen参数。在NequIP与Prophet上以机器精度复现超胞Hessian，发现常用超胞导致0.1 THz量级频率误差（深模型下随超胞尺寸收敛慢），甚至伪示低对称硅酸盐的动力学不稳定，且对色散导数量影响更大。
AI.motivation: 机器学习势的声子计算几乎都用超胞有限位移，仅在与超胞公度波矢处精确，误差取决于力常数作用范围；消息传递网络层数越深作用范围越大（最深通用模型达140 Å），使超胞方法误差大且收敛慢，亟需原胞内精确的声子方法。
AI.method: 借鉴密度泛函微扰理论思想，将动力学矩阵写为力对Bloch相位调制位移的线性响应，在消息传递势中原胞内任意波矢精确求得；相位仅进入邻原子特征聚合处，模型无需改动；再做一次求导即可解析得到群速度与模式Grüneisen参数。应用于NequIP和Prophet。
AI.result: 以机器精度复现超胞Hessian；以其为参考，常用高通量超胞的声子频率误差达零点几个THz，且随超胞增大下降缓慢（深模型尤甚）；对低对称硅酸盐超胞预测了模型本身并不存在的动力学不稳定；群速度与低温Grüneisen参数等依赖色散导数的量受影响远大于频率本身；在对称晶体中两方法计算代价相当。
AI.conclusion: 原胞内Bloch相位线性响应可精确、低成本地取代超胞有限位移获得消息传递势的完整声子色散与解析导数，避免超胞尺寸带来的系统误差与伪不稳定，是对依赖色散导数的热力学/输运性质更可靠的计算途径。

title: Magnetic order in epitaxial (La2/3Sr1/3MnO3)3/(BaTiO3)3 trilayer heterostructures
summary: The realization of artificial magnetic structures with high epitaxial quality and elevated critical temperatures remains a key challenge for spintronics. Here, we report the fabrication and characterization of epitaxial (La2/3Sr1/3MnO3)3/(BaTiO3)3 trilayer heterostructures grown by layer-by-layer laser ablation. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy, magnetization measurements, and neutron diffraction confirm their exceptional crystalline order and the absence of structural defects. Neutron diffraction reveals no antiferromagnetic at non-zero wavevector Bragg peaks, ruling out most antiferromagnetic configurations with a non zero wave vector Q. Magnetic hysteresis loops instead evidence a ferromagnetic order with a remanent moment of about 0.5 Bohr magneton per Mn atom at room temperature, persisting either in-plane or out-of-plane depending on the applied field. Our findings highlight neutron diffraction as a powerful tool for elucidating the magnetic structure of complex thin films and suggest that weak interlayer coupling through BaTiO3 leads to ferromagnetism with a high critical temperature (about 600 K).

AI.tldr: 该文用逐层激光烧蚀制备出高外延质量的(La2/3Sr1/3MnO3)3/(BaTiO3)3三明治结构，中子衍射排除非零波矢反铁磁序，磁滞回线显示室温铁磁剩磁约0.5 μB/Mn，居里温度约600 K。
AI.motivation: 自旋电子学急需高外延质量、高临界温度的人工磁结构，而复杂氧化物超晶格的磁序（尤其反铁磁构型）难以确定，需可靠手段加以甄别。
AI.method: 采用逐层激光烧蚀生长(LSMO)3/(BTO)3三层异质结；用高分辨TEM、磁化测量与中子衍射进行结构与磁性表征，以非零波矢布拉格峰的有无判定反铁磁构型。
AI.result: TEM与磁化测量证实晶体有序度极高、无明显结构缺陷；中子衍射未观察到非零Q的反铁磁峰，排除大多数非零波矢反铁磁构型；磁滞回线显示室温剩磁约0.5 μB/Mn，面内/面外随外场保持，铁磁序持续至约600 K。
AI.conclusion: 中子衍射是解析复杂薄膜磁结构的有力工具；经BaTiO3的弱层间耦合可能促成高临界温度（约600 K）的铁磁性，为高温自旋电子器件提供材料平台。

title: Oxygen on Rh(100) revisited with ultra-high precision
summary: We have reanalyzed the 0.25 and 0.50 monolayer (ML) phases of oxygen on the catalytically important Rh(100) surface by quantitative low-energy electron diffraction (LEED), variable-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) and density functional theory (DFT). For both phases, the crystallographic structure could be determined by LEED structure analyses with single-digit picometer precision enabled by ultra-low Pendry R factors of R$_\mathrm{P}$ $\approx$ 0.07. For the (2$\times$2)-O phase at 0.25 ML we find oxygen adsorbed at fourfold hollow sites in accordance to earlier results [Surf. Sci. 207 (1988) 55], however, with a pronounced buckling within the second layer of the otherwise unreconstructed substrate. For the 0.50 monolayer phase, we recently identified a (2$\sqrt{2}$ $\times$ 2$\sqrt{2}$)R45$^\circ$-4O ground state structure [Phys. Rev. Res. 8 (2026) 023296], which decomposes into a large number of nano-domains already at temperatures below 100 K. In this paper we provide a detailed analysis of the atomic structure and the ordering behavior of this phase and resolve long-standing discrepancies with the original (2$\times$2)pg model [Phys. Rev. Lett. 82 (1999) 4874]. We further prove by short-range order simulations that the coherent superposition of scattering contributions of the nano-domains leads to a virtual extinction of diffraction spots, which has concealed the true periodicity and symmetry of this phase for so long.

AI.tldr: 本文用定量LEED、变温STM和DFT重新分析了Rh(100)表面0.25和0.50 ML氧覆盖度相的结构，确定0.25 ML为四重空洞吸附并伴随第二层明显屈曲，0.50 ML实为纳米畴化的(2√2×2√2)R45°-4O基态，其畴间相干散射导致衍射斑虚假消光，长期掩盖了真实周期性。
AI.motivation: Rh(100)表面氧吸附相在催化中很重要，但0.50 ML相的原子结构和有序行为长期存在争议，原(2×2)pg模型与实际观测不符，需要澄清真实周期性与对称性。
AI.method: 结合定量低能电子衍射（LEED，Pendry R因子低至约0.07，精度达皮米级）、变温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）和密度泛函理论（DFT），并用短程有序模拟分析纳米畴的散射相干叠加。
AI.result: 0.25 ML (2×2)-O相确认氧位于四重空洞位，但基底第二层存在显著屈曲；0.50 ML相基态为(2√2×2√2)R45°-4O，在低于100 K即分解为大量纳米畴，纳米畴散射贡献的相干叠加使衍射斑虚拟消光，解释了长期以来的(2×2)pg模型误判。
AI.conclusion: 研究以高精度结构数据解决了Rh(100)-O 0.50 ML相的结构争议，并揭示纳米畴相干散射可造成衍射斑消光、隐藏真实周期性的机制，对表面结构分析方法具有普遍意义。

title: Grain boundary strength and corrosion cracking susceptibility in TiN coatings under fission product segregation
comment: 30 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables, plus Supplementary Information (2 figures, 3 tables)
summary: During fuel-cladding chemical interaction (FCCI), lanthanide fission products generated in the fuel can migrate into cladding grain boundaries (GBs), where segregation may reduce GB strength and promote corrosion cracking. We use first-principles segregation, decohesion, and bonding calculations to quantify Nd and Ce effects on six coincident-site lattice GBs in bcc Fe and TiN. For each material, segregation energies, work-of-separation values for complete interfacial cleavage, and traction-separation curves measuring ideal resistance to crack opening were evaluated within a consistent computational framework. Nd and Ce segregate favorably to both materials, and the median segregation energies are more negative in TiN, showing that TiN does not simply exclude these species from internal interfaces. The mechanical responses of Fe and TiN differ sharply. In Fe, Nd and Ce consistently reduce work of separation and peak traction, with median work-of-separation retentions of 0.72 and 0.65 and median peak-traction retentions of 0.47 and 0.43. In TiN, most decorated GBs preserve much of the clean response, with median work-of-separation retentions of 1.00 and 0.97 and median peak-traction retention of 0.85 for both fission products. Bonding analysis shows weak, occupied antibonding X-Fe replacement bonds in Fe, whereas the surrounding Ti-N network remains largely preserved after Nd/Ce segregation in TiN. These results provide atomistic support for the use of TiN and related nitride coatings to reduce FCCI damage by retaining GB strength if fission products segregate to coating internal interfaces. This retention of GB strength also provides a mechanistic descriptor for assessing coating susceptibility to FCCI-assisted corrosion cracking and environmentally assisted intergranular fracture.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理计算对比Nd、Ce在bcc Fe与TiN的6个重合位点晶界(GB)上的偏聚、解聚及成键行为，发现Nd/Ce在TiN中偏聚更强但TiN晶界强度保留明显优于Fe，支持用TiN涂层抑制FCCI损伤。
AI.motivation: FCCI中镧系裂变产物迁移进入包壳晶界并偏聚，会降低晶界强度并促发腐蚀开裂；需从原子尺度评估涂层材料（如TiN）是否能"屏蔽"这些裂变产物而非简单排斥它们。
AI.method: 统一计算框架下进行第一性原理偏聚能计算、完全界面解理功(work of separation)计算，以及表征裂纹张开理想阻力的牵引-分离曲线(traction-separation)，覆盖bcc Fe和TiN各6个重合位点晶界，并辅以成键分析。
AI.result: Nd、Ce在两材料中均有利偏聚，TiN中偏聚能中位数更负。Fe中解理功保留率中位数为0.72(Nd)、0.65(Ce)，峰值牵引力保留率0.47、0.43；TiN中解理功保留率为1.00、0.97，峰值牵引力保留率均为0.85。成键分析显示Fe中出现弱的占据反键X-Fe置换键，而TiN中Ti-N网络基本保持。
AI.conclusion: TiN及相关氮化物涂层可在裂变产物偏聚时保留晶界强度，从原子尺度支持其用于减轻FCCI损伤；晶界强度保留率可作为评估涂层FCCI辅助腐蚀开裂与环境辅助沿晶断裂敏感性的机制性指标。

title: Scalable long-range machine learning interatomic potentials with electrical response for atomistic material modeling
summary: Accurate atomistic simulations of materials under electric fields require long-range electrostatics and electrical-response modeling at length scales beyond the reach of conventional first-principles methods. Yet these capabilities remain difficult to reconcile with the scalability of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Strictly local models enable efficient spatial parallelization but neglect long-range interactions, whereas existing electrostatic extensions introduce global dependencies that hinder distributed computation. Here, we overcome this limitation by analytically separating the long-range electrostatic forces and Born effective charges (BECs) into a global electrostatics calculation and strictly local derivatives of learned latent charges. This formulation preserves the spatial decomposability of equivariant MLIPs while enabling distributed evaluation of energies, forces, stresses, and BECs across different boundary conditions. Implemented as DPA4C-LR on the \texttt{nvalchemi} platform, the framework scales to 5.2 million atoms on four GPUs at approximately twice the computational cost of its short-range backbone. Trained on energies and forces, DPA4C-LR accurately infers BECs and reproduces the field-dependent infrared spectra of water. We further demonstrate its capabilities by recovering the characteristic slim polarization hysteresis of relaxor \ce{Pb(Mg_{1/3}Nb_{2/3})O3}, which is obscured by finite-size effects in smaller simulations; predicting a room-temperature field-driven ionic conductivity of $6.8 \pm 0.7$~mS/cm in amorphous \ce{Li_{0.9}NbO_{0.9}Cl_{4.1}}; and modeling interfacial thermal transport across Si/diamond interfaces with slab-corrected electrostatics. By combining long-range physics, electrical-response inference, and distributed computation, this framework extends predictive atomistic modeling toward device-relevant length scales.

AI.tldr: 提出DPA4C-LR框架，将长程静电力与Born有效电荷解析分解为全局静电计算+局部潜电荷导数，保持等变MLIP的空间可分解性，可在4块GPU上扩展到520万原子，并准确推断BEC、复现电场依赖红外谱及多种器件尺度现象。
AI.motivation: 电场下材料的原子级模拟需要长程静电与电响应建模，但传统第一性原理受尺度限制；MLIP中严格局域模型无法描述长程相互作用，而现有静电扩展引入全局依赖，阻碍分布式并行计算。
AI.method: 将长程静电力与Born有效电荷(BEC)解析分离为全局静电求解与学习潜电荷的严格局部导数两部分，保留等变MLIP的空间可分解性，从而支持在不同边界条件下分布式求能量、力、应力与BEC；在nvalchemi平台上实现为DPA4C-LR。
AI.result: 4块GPU上扩展到520万原子，计算成本约为短程骨干的两倍；仅用能量与力训练即可准确推断BEC并复现水的电场依赖红外谱；复现PMN弛豫铁电体的细长极化迟滞；预测非晶Li0.9NbO0.9Cl4.1室温场驱动离子电导6.8±0.7 mS/cm；用slab修正静电极化模拟Si/金刚石界面热输运。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合长程物理、电响应推断与分布式计算，该框架把预测性原子模拟推进到器件相关尺度。

title: Symmetry constraints on magnon-induced dynamics of skyrmion helicity in frustrated magnets
summary: The helicity of a magnetic skyrmion in a centrosymmetric frustrated magnet is a soft collective coordinate and a candidate variable for encoding quantum information. Its coherence is ultimately influenced by coupling to the magnon environment, which is commonly incorporated only phenomenologically. Here we combine a microscopic Keldysh treatment of the helicity--magnon coupling to resolve the contribution of individual magnon modes to the effective helicity dynamics. In the U(1)-symmetric model, the magnon bath generates, to leading order, a reactive helicity mass renormalization. When U(1) symmetry is broken, additional direct helicity--magnon couplings become allowed. In the presence of finite magnon lifetimes, these couplings generate an Ohmic contribution to the low-frequency helicity dynamics. The spatial symmetry of the perturbation determines which magnon sectors contribute to this damping, providing mode-resolved selection rules for the helicity--magnon coupling. Thus, we establish a microscopic connection between helicity dynamics and the excitation spectrum of frustrated skyrmions and identify the symmetry constraints governing dissipation of helicity-based quantum states.

AI.tldr: 利用微观Keldysh方法研究阻挫磁体中skyrmion螺旋度与磁振子环境的耦合，揭示其有效动力学与阻尼的对称性选择规则。
AI.motivation: 中心对称阻挫磁体中skyrmion的螺旋度可作为编码量子信息的软集体坐标，其相干性受磁振子环境影响，但以往仅以唯象方式处理该耦合，缺乏微观图像。
AI.method: 采用微观Keldysh非平衡场论处理螺旋度—磁振子耦合，逐模分辨各磁振子模式对螺旋度有效动力学的贡献；分别分析U(1)对称模型与U(1)破缺情形，并在有限磁振子寿命下考察低频行为。
AI.result: U(1)对称模型中磁振子浴至领头阶仅产生反应性（无耗散）的螺旋度质量重整；U(1)破缺后出现额外直接耦合，在有限磁振子寿命下产生低频Ohmic阻尼，且微扰的空间对称性决定哪些磁振子扇区参与阻尼，给出模分辨选择规则。
AI.conclusion: 建立了阻挫skyrmion螺旋度动力学与激发谱的微观联系，并明确了支配螺旋度量子态耗散的对称性约束。

title: Learning the self-energy through equivariant neural networks
summary: The electronic self-energy determines the single-particle Green's function and, through it, quasiparticle energies and spectral functions, but computing it from first principles is expensive and it is a difficult machine-learning target: complex-valued, matrix-valued in a local-orbital basis, and dependent on a continuous frequency. We predict the dynamical correlation part of the imaginary-frequency G_0W_0 self-energy matrix of molecules from atomic species and coordinates with an E(3)-equivariant message-passing network, the rotational covariance of the orbital-space matrix being imposed by the architecture itself and the static exchange part taken from the density-functional reference. Frequency enters either as an explicit network input or through frequency-specific output heads, and the predicted matrices are continued to the real axis in a representation in which causality and a non-negative spectral density hold by construction. The frequency-conditioned model reproduces matrix elements to below 1 meV on the imaginary axis for the systems studied here, and that accuracy survives the continuation: for water clusters, including a tetramer absent from the training set, and for chemically diverse molecules from QM9, the reconstructed spectral functions follow the G_0W_0 reference peak by peak and the frontier quasiparticle levels are recovered to a few tens of meV. Learning the self-energy on the imaginary axis is therefore a practical route to real-frequency spectra: once the model is trained, and given the density-functional reference it is built on, a new geometry costs no explicit G_0W_0 calculation.

AI.tldr: 用E(3)等变消息传递网络从原子种类与坐标预测分子G0W0自能虚频关联部分，并解析延拓到实轴，重现谱函数和准粒子能级。
AI.motivation: 第一性原理计算电子自能代价高昂，且其目标性质（复值、局域轨道基下的矩阵值、依赖连续频率）使其成为困难机器学习对象。
AI.method: 采用E(3)等变消息传递网络，架构本身保证轨道空间矩阵的旋转协变性；静态交换部分取自DFT参考；频率以显式网络输入或频率专用输出头引入；预测矩阵在保证因果性与非负谱密度的表示下延拓到实轴。
AI.result: 虚轴上矩阵元误差低于1 meV；水团簇（含训练集外的四聚体）与QM9多样分子上，重构谱函数逐峰吻合G0W0参考，前沿准粒子能级恢复误差仅数十meV。
AI.conclusion: 在虚轴学习自能是获得实频谱的实用途径：模型训练好后，给定其所依赖的DFT参考，新几何无需显式G0W0计算。

title: Magnetic tunnel junctions of twisted La2/3Sr1/3MnO3 freestanding bilayers
summary: Transition metal oxides (TMOs) host a variety of emergent spintronic or multiferroic functionalities owing to the intricate interplay between lattice, orbital, charge, and spin degrees of freedom. Recent advances in epitaxial lift-off and dry transfer techniques using water-soluble sacrificial layers enables stacking and twisting of freestanding membranes of such strongly correlated oxides, providing even richer physical properties and functionalities. To date, the twisted junctions of TMOs have been mainly investigated in insulators, focusing on their structural and dielectric properties. Here, we demonstrate that the twisted bilayer membranes of La2/3Sr1/3MnO3, a prototypical half-metallic ferromagnetic metal TMO, offer a magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ) with their van der Waals (vdW) gap acting as a tunnel barrier. The twisted junctions of La2/3Sr1/3MnO3 exhibit tunnelling magnetoresistance (TMR) effect with respect to relative orientation of magnetizations of top and bottom membranes. In addition, high-field magnetoresistance shows uniaxial anisotropy, which can be assigned to tunnelling anisotropic magnetoresistance (TAMR) effect reflecting rhombohedral distortion of fully-relaxed La2/3Sr1/3MnO3. The demonstration of TMR and TAMR effects suggests that spin and in-plane momentum degrees of freedom of 3d electrons are conserved across the twisted junctions of TMOs, opening a new avenue for realizing strongly correlated twistronics utilizing electron coherence through tunnelling processes.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了半金属铁磁金属氧化物La2/3Sr1/3MnO3的双层扭转薄膜结，其vdW间隙充当隧穿势垒，从而实现了磁隧道结(MJT)，观测到隧穿磁阻(TMR)和隧穿各向异性磁阻(TAMR)效应。
AI.motivation: TMO因晶格、轨道、电荷、自旋自由度耦合而具丰富功能；外延剥离与干法转移技术使自由-standing氧化物膜可堆叠扭转，但迄今扭转TMO结主要研究绝缘体，缺乏对金属性/半金属铁磁TMO扭转结的输运与自旋探究。
AI.method: 利用水溶性牺牲层的外延剥离与干法转移，制备完全弛豫的La2/3Sr1/3MnO3自由-standing薄膜并堆叠成扭转双层结；以层间vdW间隙作隧穿势垒，测量其随上下层磁化相对取向的TMR，以及高场下的磁阻各向异性(TAMR)。
AI.result: 扭转La2/3Sr1/3MnO3结表现出依赖上下膜磁化相对取向的TMR效应；高场磁阻呈单轴各向异性，归因于反映完全弛豫LSMO菱面体畸变的TAMR效应。
AI.conclusion: TMR与TAMR的观测表明3d电子的自旋与面内动量自由度在TMO扭转结中得以保持，为利用隧穿过程中的电子相干性实现强关联扭转电子学开辟新途径。

title: Intercalation of Ultrathin Ferromagnetic Iron Films at the Graphene/SiC Interface
summary: The intercalation of high-quality PASG-grown (polymer-assisted sublimation growth) zero-layer graphene on 4H-SiC(0001) with iron is studied using a deposition-and-annealing approach. We find that unlike other metals, Fe does not easily intercalate, and the intercalation procedure has to be balanced with the formation of iron silicides and graphitic carbon at the interface. After successful intercalation, the ultrathin iron films are protected against oxidation by the covering graphene sheet, and retain ferromagnetic behaviour with an in-plane easy axis even at room temperature. When exposed to a selenium-rich atmosphere at elevated temperatures, an almost complete exchange of Fe by Se is observed, imposing a major restriction for the formation of multi-element 2D compounds via sequential intercalation schemes.

AI.tldr: 研究Fe插层到PASG生长的零层石墨烯/4H-SiC中的可行性，发现Fe插层需与硅化物和石墨碳形成相竞争，成功插层后Fe膜受石墨烯保护抗氧化并保持室温面内易轴铁磁性，但高温富Se气氛下Fe几乎被Se完全置换。
AI.motivation: 探索金属Fe能否插层进入零层石墨烯与SiC衬底之间，以获得受石墨烯保护的超薄铁膜及铁磁性二维体系，并评估顺序插层法构建多元素二维化合物的可行性。
AI.method: 采用沉积-退火（deposition-and-annealing）方法，对PASG（聚合物辅助升华生长）制备的高质量零层石墨烯/4H-SiC(0001)进行Fe插层，并进一步在高温富Se气氛中处理考察元素置换行为。
AI.result: Fe不同于其他金属，不易插层；插层过程须与界面处铁硅化物和石墨碳的生成相平衡。成功插层后，超薄铁膜被石墨烯覆盖保护免于氧化，并在室温下仍保持面内易轴铁磁性。高温富Se气氛中Fe几乎被Se完全置换。
AI.conclusion: 石墨烯可有效封装并保护超薄Fe膜并保持其铁磁性；但元素置换现象对基于顺序插层构建多元素二维化合物构成重要限制。

title: Analysis of Transient Microscopy Data in Reciprocal Space
summary: Transient microscopy has evolved to include a family of well-established techniques for studying the spatiotemporal dynamics of excited states in a variety of materials systems. In these methods, a laser pulse is focused to locally excite a material, and the subsequent evolution of the excited species is visualized to extract transport parameters such as diffusivities. Typically, transport coefficients are extracted from experimental datasets using curve-fitting methods to analyze the change in the mean squared displacement (MSD) of the spatial profiles over time. However, this approach can lead to inaccurate or misleading diffusivity values under many common experimental conditions, and is only formally accurate for the case of a single diffusing species. In this work, we introduce a new approach to the analysis of transient microscopy data based on the evolution of profile shapes in reciprocal space. We use simulated datasets to quantitatively analyze the performance of our proposed methods and compare them to current state-of-the-art analysis techniques. We demonstrate that reciprocal-space-based analysis methods have the highest overall performance in terms of accuracy and precision for normal diffusive transport over a range of realistic initial conditions and signal-to-noise ratios. Furthermore, we highlight the limitations of using MSD alone to characterize anomalous transport in materials, and we show how analysis of spatial frequencies can yield a more comprehensive understanding of complex excited-state dynamics and their underlying physical mechanisms. Our results show that reciprocal-space-based analysis methods are powerful tools for characterizing and quantifying many different types of transport behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于倒空间（reciprocal space）中空间频率分布形状演化的瞬态显微数据分析方法，用于更准确提取输运系数。
AI.motivation: 传统瞬态显微技术通过拟合空间分布均方位移（MSD）随时间变化来提取扩散系数，但在许多常见实验条件下会给出不准确甚至误导性的结果，且仅对单一扩散组分在形式上成立。
AI.method: 提出基于倒空间中分布形状演化的分析框架；利用模拟数据集定量评估其性能，并与当前最先进（基于MSD）的分析方法进行对比。
AI.result: 在一系列真实初始条件和信噪比下，倒空间方法在常规扩散输运的准确性和精确度上整体表现最佳；同时揭示仅用MSD表征反常输运的局限，并展示空间频率分析可更全面理解复杂激发态动力学及物理机制。
AI.conclusion: 倒空间分析方法是表征和量化多种输运行为的有力工具。

title: Type 1.5 vortex bags in single component Ginzburg-Landau models with higher order potentials
summary: We demonstrate the existence of type 1.5 like superconductivity in a single component Ginzburg-Landau model with a higher order potential. The model exhibits two competing superconducting Meissner states (MS), each of which has its own pair of length scales (coherence length and penetration depth). The solutions take the form of bags that contain vortices of one vacuum inside the other. This gives rise to four different types of vortex interaction, where one set of length scales determines vortex interactions inside the bags and the other set between the bags. Hence, within the bag the vortices can repel or attract and the bags themselves can repel or attract depending on the hierarchy of four length scales. When vortices repel within the bag, solutions act similarly to those in type 1.5 multicomponent superconductors, but in a single component system.

AI.tldr: 本文在带高阶势的单分量Ginzburg-Landau模型中证明存在类似1.5型超导性：两个竞争的Meissner态各自拥有相干长度与穿透深度，形成内部含涡旋的"袋"结构，从而产生四种涡旋相互作用类型。
AI.motivation: 1.5型超导此前只在多分量（多带）超导体中被讨论，因其需要多个竞争序参量。作者希望探究单分量模型是否也能出现类似行为，以拓展对涡旋相互作用类型的理解。
AI.method: 采用含高阶势项（六阶或更高）的单分量Ginzburg-Landau模型，该模型具有两个竞争的Meissner态，每个态有独立的相干长度和穿透深度共四个长度尺度。解析求解由一种真空包裹另一种真空涡旋的"袋"（bag）解，并按四个长度尺度的层级关系分类涡旋相互作用。
AI.result: 袋内涡旋可由一套长度尺度决定吸引或排斥，袋与袋之间的相互作用则由另一套尺度决定，共给出四种涡旋相互作用类型。当袋内涡旋相互排斥时，其行为类似于1.5型多分量超导体，但仅需单分量模型即可实现。
AI.conclusion: 单分量高阶Ginzburg-Landau模型即可实现类1.5型超导性，说明1.5型涡旋物理并非多分量系统所独有，为设计涡旋相互作用提供了更简单的理论框架。

title: Limits from nonlinear loss of spin-orbit-torque control of magnon transport
summary: Controlling magnon currents is central to the development of magnonic devices, which exploit spin excitations for information transport without charge flow. Here, we use the spin-orbit torque (SOT) from a Pt gate to control the effective magnon damping in three-terminal devices fabricated from low-damping lithium aluminum ferrite (LAFO) thin films and identify the nonlinear damping that ultimately limits the gate response. With increasing gate current, the nonlocal magnon signal initially increases, but saturates and subsequently decreases above a critical gate current density. Brillouin light scattering microscopy reveals that this turnover coincides with the emergence of an SOT-driven auto-oscillation mode localized beneath the gate, whose frequency continuously redshifts with increasing gate current, characteristic of large-amplitude nonlinear dynamics, and with a suppression of the propagating magnon population away from the gate. Micromagnetic simulations reproduce the observed nonmonotonic gate response only when an amplitude-dependent effective damping is included, indicating that nonlinear losses, rather than saturation of spin injection, limit the degree of magnon modulation. Our results show that SOT compensation of magnon damping is ultimately limited by nonlinear damping attributed to auto-oscillations, providing a framework for understanding the limits of magnon current modulation in magnetic insulators.

AI.tldr: 该文利用Pt栅极的自旋轨道矩(SOT)调控LAFO三端器件中的有效磁振子阻尼，发现栅极响应受SOT驱动的自振荡引起的非线性阻尼限制。
AI.motivation: 控制磁振子电流对无电荷流动的信息传输型磁振子器件至关重要，但栅极调控磁振子阻尼的限度及失效机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 在低阻尼锂铝铁氧体(LAFO)薄膜三端器件上，用Pt栅极施加SOT，测非局域磁振子信号随栅极电流的变化；用布里渊光散射显微成像观察模式；用微磁模拟进行对比验证。
AI.result: 随栅极电流增大，磁振子信号先增大，后在临界电流密度以上饱和并下降；此转变伴随栅极下方SOT驱动的自振荡模式出现，其频率随电流连续红移（大振幅非线性特征），远处传播磁振子被抑制；微磁模拟仅在引入幅度依赖的有效阻尼时才能重现非单调响应，说明限制调控幅度的是非线性损耗而非自旋注入饱和。
AI.conclusion: SOT对磁振子阻尼的补偿最终受自振荡导致的非线性阻尼限制，为理解磁性绝缘体中磁振子电流调制的极限提供了框架。

title: Temperature and Thickness Dependent Spin Current Transmission through Epitaxial Antiferromagnetic α-Fe2O3
summary: Antiferromagnetic insulator α-Fe2O3 is a potential medium for coherent motion of spin waves over relatively large distances, allowing non-dissipative transfer of information between circuit elements. However, the structural defects and temperature dependent spin reorientations in this oxide impact the propagation. Understanding how the magnetic state of an antiferromagnetic insulator affects spin-current transmission is therefore important for elucidating the mechanisms governing spin transport. Here, we report spin-current transmission through epitaxial α-Fe2O3 thin films sandwiched between Permalloy and Pt. Using spin pumping and inverse spin Hall effect, we observe a finite symmetric dc voltage across the Pt layer over the temperature range 1.6 to 300 K for alpha-Fe2O3 thicknesses of 0, 30, 40, and 100 nm. The symmetric voltage coefficient Ks exhibits two approximately linear temperature regimes, separated by a characteristic temperature T* whose value depends on the thickness of the α-Fe2O3 layer. Further, the dc magnetization measurements on some of the samples suggest that the T* is correlated with the spin reorientation transition (Morin transition) in α-Fe2O3. Interestingly, a significantly larger magnitude of dKs/dT is noted below the characteristic temperature T*. The observed thickness and temperature dependent spin-current transmission indicates a sensitivity to the magnetic state of the insulating hematite layer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了外延α-Fe2O3薄膜（0–100 nm）夹于Permalloy与Pt之间的自旋流透射，发现对称电压系数Ks随温度呈两段近线性变化，转折温度T*与Morin转变相关且依赖厚度。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁绝缘体α-Fe2O3有望实现自旋波长距离相干传输与无耗散信息传递，但其结构缺陷和随温度变化的自旋重取向会影响传播。需要弄清反铁磁绝缘体的磁态如何影响自旋流透射，以阐明自旋输运机制。
AI.method: 制备Permalloy/α-Fe2O3/Pt三明治结构外延薄膜（α-Fe2O3厚度0、30、40、100 nm），采用自旋泵浦与逆自旋霍尔效应，在1.6–300 K范围内测量Pt层中的对称直流电压；并结合直流磁化测量分析T*与Morin转变的关联。
AI.result: 在整个温区均观测到有限的对称直流电压；对称电压系数Ks呈两个近线性温区，由特征温度T*分隔，T*随α-Fe2O3厚度变化；磁化测量表明T*与α-Fe2O3的Morin自旋重取向转变相关；在T*以下dKs/dT幅度显著更大。
AI.conclusion: 自旋流透射对赤铁矿绝缘层磁态（含Morin转变）表现出显著的厚度与温度依赖敏感性，说明反铁磁绝缘体的磁态调控自旋流传输。

title: Scaling of entanglement with distance between subsystems: detection of phase transitions in the $t'$-$π$-flux model
summary: The system-size scaling of bipartite entanglement can be used to detect phase transitions. We develop a related approach for strongly correlated electron models where large density matrices or large system size scaling are inaccessible. To this end, we demonstrate that phase transitions of various kinds are signaled by a sharp signature in the first- or second-order logarithmic derivatives of the negativity measuring entanglement between small clusters at varying distances. Crucially, we show how to mitigate the effect of quantum Monte Carlo noise at large distances when computing the negativity. Our focus is on the $t'$-$π$-flux Hubbard model using auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo simulations. It has the particular advantage of showing three distinct phase transitions in a single model: semimetal to band insulator, semimetal to antiferromagnetic Mott insulator, and a magnetic order-disorder transition belonging to the Gaussian, Gross-Neveu, and O(3) Wilson-Fisher universality classes, respectively.

AI.tldr: 通过小团簇间负度（negativity）对距离的一阶/二阶对数导数中的尖锐信号来探测相变，并用该方法（含QMC噪声抑制）研究t'-π通量Hubbard模型中的三种相变。
AI.motivation: 体系尺寸标度下的双分纠缠可探测相变，但强关联电子模型中大密度矩阵或大体系尺寸标度往往不可获得，需要一种不依赖大尺度标度的纠缠判据。
AI.method: 计算不同距离处小团簇间纠缠的负度，取其对距离的一阶与二阶对数导数；提出抑制大距离处量子蒙特卡洛噪声的方法；用辅助场量子蒙特卡洛模拟t'-π通量Hubbard模型。
AI.result: 多种相变均在负度对数导数中呈现尖锐特征；该模型给出三种相变——半金属到能带绝缘体、半金属到反铁磁Mott绝缘体、以及磁序-无序转变，分别属于Gaussian、Gross-Neveu和O(3) Wilson-Fisher普适类。
AI.conclusion: 小团簇负度的对数导数可作为强关联电子体系中探测相变的实用手段，配合QMC噪声抑制可在无法做大尺度标度时识别相变及其普适类。

title: Engineering nonrelativistic spin splitting in semiconductors by altermagnetic proximity
summary: Altermagnets combine vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent, nonrelativistic spin splitting, offering functionalities attractive for spintronics and quantum devices. Their practical use, however, is constrained by the limited availability of materials that simultaneously possess the required altermagnetic symmetry, semiconducting electronic structure, and weak spin-orbit coupling. Here we show that these requirements can instead be separated between constituent materials through proximity engineering. We develop an analytical theory for a conventional semiconductor coupled to a gapped $d$-wave altermagnet and demonstrate that virtual tunneling transfers the altermagnetic spin splitting to the semiconductor. Crucially, the induced nonrelativistic and relativistic spin splittings exhibit qualitatively different dependences on band alignment. Virtual processes involving the valence and conduction bands of the altermagnet can reinforce the altermagnetic splitting while contributing with opposite signs to the interfacial Rashba coupling. Consequently, electrostatic tuning can access a regime in which the Rashba splitting vanishes while a sizable $d$-wave spin splitting persists. Exact diagonalization of the full heterostructure model confirms the analytical theory and establishes the robustness of this mechanism beyond the perturbative regime. Our results identify altermagnetic proximity as a route for engineering nonrelativistic spin-split electronic states in established semiconductor platforms, providing a general strategy for disentangling magnetic and relativistic spin interactions in quantum heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 通过在普通半导体上邻近耦合带隙的d波交变磁体，可将交变磁自旋分裂"转移"到半导体中，且可调控至Rashba分裂消失而d波分裂保留的区间。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体虽兼具零净磁化与动量依赖的自旋分裂，但实用化受限于同时满足交变磁对称性、半导体电子结构和弱自旋轨道耦合的材料极少。作者提出将这些要求分离到不同材料中，用邻近效应加以解决。
AI.method: 建立传统半导体与带隙d波交变磁体耦合的解析理论，研究虚拟隧穿如何传递交变磁自旋分裂；分析诱导的非相对论性与相对论性自旋分裂对能带对齐的依赖（价带与导带的虚过程对交变磁分裂与界面Rashba耦合贡献相反符号）；并对完整异质结模型做精确对角化以验证。
AI.result: 诱导的非相对论与相对论自旋分裂对能带对齐定性不同；静电调控可进入Rashba分裂为零而可观的d波自旋分裂仍存在的区域；精确对角化证实解析理论，并表明该机制在微扰区之外仍然稳健。
AI.conclusion: 交变磁邻近效应为在成熟半导体平台上工程化非相对论自旋分裂电子态提供了途径，是解耦量子异质结构中磁性与相对论自旋相互作用的通用策略。

title: Transport and thermalization under noncommuting localized constraints
summary: We investigate the effects of spatially localized conserved quantities on transport and thermalization in quantum and classical many-body systems. We consider several related models: the integrable quantum Volterra model, its nonintegrable classical limit, and two cellular automata derived from the latter. Although localized constraints are often associated with lattice gauge theories, our models do not admit such an interpretation. In systems with discrete degrees of freedom, these constraints induce uniform fragmentation of the Hilbert or configuration space. In the quantum Volterra model, we derive an exact mapping of the dynamics within each Hilbert-space fragment onto a quantum chiral Potts chain. We find that energy transport is ballistic, with identical transport coefficients across all fragments. In the nonintegrable classical limit, energy transport is diffusive, and we similarly find the diffusion constant to be independent of whether or not the constraints are fixed (resolved). Finally, in the cellular automata, we show that, despite leaving transport unaffected, localized constraints lead to a strong breakdown of local ergodicity.

AI.tldr: 论文研究空间局域守恒量对量子与经典多体系统输运和热化的影响，发现局域约束虽不影响输运系数，却会强烈破坏局域遍历性。
AI.motivation: 局域约束（常与格点规范理论联系）如何影响多体系统的输运与热化尚不清楚，且需区分量子与经典、可积与非可积情形。
AI.method: 研究可积量子Volterra模型、其非可积经典极限及两个元胞自动机；推导量子情形下各Hilbert空间碎片内动力学到量子手性Potts链的精确映射，并比较约束固定与否时的输运系数。
AI.result: 离散自由度系统中局域约束导致Hilbert/构型空间均匀碎裂；量子Volterra中能量输运为弹道型且各碎片输运系数相同；经典极限中输运为扩散型且扩散常数与约束是否固定无关；元胞自动机中输运不受影响但局域遍历性强烈破坏。
AI.conclusion: 局域守恒量可均匀碎裂相空间而不改变输运行为，但显著破坏局域遍历性，表明输运与热化可由不同机制支配。

title: Orbital Angular Momentum Currents and Textures in a Multiorbital Double Helix
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to the Physical Review
summary: The microscopic origin of chirality induced spin selectivity (CISS) in biomolecular structures has traditionally been discussed in terms of spin orbit coupling and spin angular momentum. However, orbital angular momentum (OAM) is increasingly recognized as a more direct electronic response to molecular chirality. A helical hopping network built only from s orbitals can support an itinerant orbital moment and an orbital Edelstein response, but such a basis has no local atomic OAM and therefore omits the complementary contribution arising from coherence among active p orbitals. Here we construct a six-band multiorbital double helix model parameterized by characteristic B form DNA geometry and hopping scales. The model incorporates major minor groove asymmetry, an axial base pair offset representing stagger, and compositional inequivalence between the two strands, providing structural control parameters with which the orbital response can be tuned. Inter strand hybridization generates a full three component atomic OAM texture in the corotating local helical frame, including a radial component absent in the corresponding single helix model. We separately evaluate the itinerant OAM using the Bloch wave packet formulation of orbital magnetization and identify an additional inter-strand circulation channel unique to the double-helix connectivity. The resulting atomic and itinerant responses have distinct microscopic origins, magnitudes, and temperature dependences, establishing a multiorbital framework for geometry controlled angular momentum generation and transport in chiral molecular conductors.

AI.tldr: 构建六带多轨道双螺旋模型，揭示DNA中原子OAM与巡游OAM两种不同微观机制。
AI.motivation: CISS效应传统上用自旋轨道耦合与自旋角动量解释，但轨道角动量（OAM）被认为是对分子手性更直接的电子响应。仅含s轨道的螺旋跳跃网络虽能支持巡游轨道磁矩，却缺少局域原子OAM，也遗漏了活性p轨道间相干产生的互补贡献，因此需要多轨道模型。
AI.method: 以B型DNA几何和跳跃尺度参数化，构建六带多轨道双螺旋模型。纳入大/小沟不对称、代表stagger的轴向碱基对偏移、两条链的组分不等价等结构调控参数；引入链间杂化；用Bloch波包轨道磁化公式分别计算巡游OAM。
AI.result: 链间杂化在共转局域螺旋坐标系中产生完整三分量的原子OAM纹理，包含单螺旋模型所无的径向分量；并识别出双螺旋连接特有的额外链间环流通道。原子OAM与巡游OAM响应在微观起源、量级和温度依赖上各不相同。
AI.conclusion: 建立了多轨道框架，用于手性分子导体中几何调控的角动量产生与输运，说明原子与巡游OAM是互补而非同源的贡献。

title: Anyonic Neural Network Wavefunctions
summary: The macroscopic behavior of a non-interacting gas of Abelian anyons has remained unsettled for many decades. Prior numerical methods employing exact diagonalization in the continuum and on the plane have been limited to small system sizes, at most $N = 4$ anyons. Using the rapidly developing technology of neural network wavefunctions, we develop variational ansatze appropriate for studying continuum models of the Abelian anyon gas. The neural network architecture, which we call "AnyNet", is capable of exactly enforcing the non-analytic short-distance behavior induced by the anyonic statistics. We demonstrate excellent agreement with exact diagonalization for $N=4$ anyons, obtain accurate results up to $N = 16$ for intermediate statistics, and study up to $N=20$ for almost-fermionic anyons, matching perturbative results within a 0.4% discrepancy. We use this methodology to study anyons in a harmonic trap, and anyonic atoms as a model for anyon binding to impurities. We study the structure of anyonic wavefunctions as the statistics parameter is varied. We focus on the single-particle density, the pair density, the angular momentum, and the scaling of the wavefunction as multiple anyons coalesce. This work opens doors to understanding the macroscopic behavior of anyons, for which rich phases have been predicted theoretically.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出神经网络波函数Ansatz "AnyNet"，用于研究连续平面上的非相互作用阿贝尔任意子气体，将可控计算规模从N≤4提升到N≤20。
AI.motivation: 非相互作用阿贝尔任意子气体的宏观行为数十年未有定论；此前基于连续空间精确对角化的数值方法受限于极小系统尺寸（最多N=4），难以探索理论预言的丰富相。
AI.method: 基于神经网络波函数（变分蒙特卡洛）构建"AnyNet"架构，能够精确强制实现任意子统计所导致的短距离非解析行为；用于研究谐振势阱中的任意子，以及作为任意子束缚于杂质的"任意子原子"模型；分析单粒子密度、对密度、角动量及多任意子聚合时波函数的标度行为。
AI.result: 在N=4时与精确对角化高度一致；中间统计量下精确计算至N=16；近费米任意子达N=20，与微扰结果偏差在0.4%以内。
AI.conclusion: 该方法大幅扩展了任意子气体可研究体系规模，为理解任意子宏观行为及理论预言的丰富相态开辟了道路。

title: Ionic switching between supermagnetic states
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 27 pages of supporting information
summary: Supermagnetic states are typically set during synthesis. Changing and retaining these states requires sustained external stimulus. Without resynthesis or continued stimulus, we show, for the first time, a reversible magneto-ionic switching between superferromagnetic (SFM) and superspin-glass (SSG) states using room-temperature Li-ion transport. We utilize the incomplete lithiation of NiO into nanoscale Ni and Li2O to switch between the states. Lithiation generates a fragmented nano-Ni network that strengthens dipolar interactions and promotes SFM order with stronger memory and higher room-temperature moments. Delithiation partially regenerates NiO and drives the system into an SSG state with higher low-temperature coercivity and sharper temperature-selective memory. The interconversion between SFM and SSG persists at all measured subsequent lithiation-delithiation cycles, creating a general framework for supermagnetic switching.

AI.tldr: 利用室温Li离子输运实现超铁磁(SFM)与超自旋玻璃(SSG)态的可逆磁离子切换。
AI.motivation: 超磁态通常在合成时确定，改变并保持这些状态需要持续的外部刺激，缺乏无需再合成或持续刺激即可切换的手段。
AI.method: 通过NiO向纳米Ni与Li2O的不完全锂化/脱锂实现态切换：锂化生成碎片化纳米Ni网络，增强偶极相互作用并促成SFM；脱锂部分再生NiO，使体系进入SSG态。
AI.result: 锂化后SFM态具更强记忆与更高室温磁矩；脱锂后SSG态具更高低温矫顽力与更尖锐的温度选择性记忆；SFM–SSG互变在所有后续锂化-脱锂循环中保持。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明无需持续刺激即可可逆切换超磁态，为超磁切换提供通用框架。

title: A Physics-based and Geometry-aware Reduced-order Framework for Accelerated Part-Scale Thermomechanical Simulation of Additive Friction Stir Deposition Process
summary: Additive friction stir deposition (AFSD) is attractive for naval and aerospace sustainment because it enables high rate, solid state near net shape fabrication and repair of large metallic components. However, full part scale thermomechanical simulations remain computationally demanding because of the moving heat source, progressive material deposition, and evolving geometry. This work presents a physics-based and geometry-aware reduced order framework for rapid prediction of temperature and residual stress fields in part scale AFSD builds. The transient temperature field is represented using a tensor product quadratic B spline basis on a fixed Cartesian background grid, while arbitrary part geometries are embedded using a signed distance function (SDF) and a smooth material indicator. Residual stresses are recovered through an inherent strain formulation in which an offline thermo elasto plastic representative volume element (RVE) simulation supplies a calibrated eigenstrain field that is spatially scaled using the part scale peak temperature history. The thermal formulation is evaluated against published numerical and experimental AFSD data and two sample multilayer builds are simulated as demonstrations. For a four layer thin-wall build, the thermal solution requires approximately 22 s compared to 806 s for the finite element model, while the complete thermo-mechanical framework requires approximately 86.4 s compared to 2,406 s. For a larger 20 layer hollow cylindrical build, the reduced order thermal simulations requires 0.148 to 0.152 h compared with 1.8 h for the finite element model, corresponding to thermal speed-ups of approximately 11.8 to 12.2 times. The complete thermomechanical framework requires 0.346 h compared to 5.4 h for the full finite element analysis, providing an overall speed-up of approximately 15.6 times.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理驱动、几何感知的降阶框架，快速预测零件级增材摩擦搅拌沉积(AFSD)的温度场与残余应力场，相较有限元实现约12–16倍加速。
AI.motivation: AFSD适于海军与航空航天大型金属构件的固态近净成形与修复，但零件级热力仿真因移动热源、逐层沉积和几何演化而计算代价高昂，难以快速预测温度与残余应力。
AI.method: 以固定笛卡尔背景网格上的张量积二次B样条基表示瞬态温度场；用符号距离函数与光滑材料指示函数嵌入任意几何；残余应力通过固有应变法恢复，由离线热弹塑性RVE仿真标定特征应变场，并按零件级峰值温度历史进行空间缩放。
AI.result: 热模型经已发表数值与实验AFSD数据验证，并演示两个多层构建：4层薄壁件热解约22 s（FEM 806 s）、完整热力框架86.4 s（FEM 2406 s）；20层空心圆柱件热解0.148–0.152 h（FEM 1.8 h，加速约11.8–12.2倍），完整热力框架0.346 h（FEM 5.4 h，整体加速约15.6倍）。
AI.conclusion: 该降阶框架在保持物理可解释性与几何适应性前提下，显著降低零件级AFSD热力分析成本，为大型构件制造与修复的快速工艺预测提供可行途径。

title: Electrochemical Molecular Dynamics within the Finite-Field Framework
comment: Main text: 16 pages, 6 figures, 3 appendices. Supporting information: 20 pages, 8 figures
summary: Electrochemical processes at charged interfaces lie at the heart of modern technologies and their continued improvement depends on insights into the relevant atomistic processes. However, the necessary tools to impose constant-voltage conditions in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations typically directly target the electrode charge, making their extension to methods that go beyond an empirical description of metals more cumbersome. In this work, we propose an MD protocol to realize a thermodynamic ensemble in which voltage control is attained, but which is formulated purely within the framework of finite-field simulations in 3D periodic boundary conditions. We show a derivation and implementation of such a control device, which we coin an electrostat, in the ELECTRODE package within LAMMPS. Our simulations systematically benchmark the derived theory against other established approaches, for example, showing its equivalence to a potentiostat, and quantify the importance of properly accounting for ensemble fluctuations. We find that for systems of several thousands of atoms, one obtains the same equilibrium properties with the electrostat as with a simpler constant-field simulation. The difference between the two methods only manifests itself at smaller length scales, thereby establishing practical limits for the inclusion of voltage fluctuations in atomistic simulations of electrochemical systems. The strength of this framework also lies in its simplicity of extension to first-principles ab initio and reactive machine-learning potentials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在LAMMPS的ELECTRODE包中实现"electrostat"——一种三维周期边界下基于有限场模拟的恒压（电化学热力学）系综MD方法，可替代传统恒电位仪，且易于推广到第一性原理与反应性机器学习势。
AI.motivation: 电化学界面过程对现代技术至关重要，但现有恒压MD工具通常直接针对电极电荷进行控制，难以推广到超越经验金属描述的方法（如从头算）。因此需要一种纯有限场框架下、不依赖经验金属模型即可实现电压控制的分子动力学协议。
AI.method: 作者在有限场（finite-field）模拟的三维周期边界条件下推导并实现了一个"恒压控制装置"，称为electrostat，并集成于LAMMPS的ELECTRODE包。随后用系统性的基准测试将其与已有方法（如恒电位仪）对比，并量化系综涨落被正确纳入的重要性。
AI.result: 在数千原子体系中，electrostat与更简单的恒场模拟给出相同的平衡性质；二者仅在较小尺度上出现差异，从而界定出在原子尺度模拟中纳入电压涨落的实际适用范围。同时验证了electrostat与恒电位仪的等价性。
AI.conclusion: electrostat提供了一种简单、可推广的恒压MD框架，其优势在于易于扩展到第一性原理从头算和反应性机器学习势，为电化学原子尺度模拟提供了实用边界与指导。

title: Active Learning for Interatomic Potentials: A Review of Uncertainty-Driven Data Efficiency
summary: Developing a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) that is accurate for the specific conditions under which it will be applied, rather than simply for the predefined configurations chosen by the model developer, is a significant challenge in atomistic simulation. Active learning (AL) addresses this challenge by closing the loop between candidate generation, data selection, reference calculation, and model updating. Here, we survey more than seventy studies, with an emphasis on work from 2020 to 2026, to understand how active learning has evolved from a niche, on-the-fly training technique for query-by-committee and Gaussian process force fields into a diverse family of data-efficient strategies. he reviewed examples include on-the-fly molecular dynamics, active data selection for fine-tuning pretrained models, kernel- and representation-based acquisition using frozen pretrained models, and reaction-aware sampling for chemical systems far from equilibrium. We explore the use of active learning in elemental and alloy mechanics, hydrogen and ion diffusion, ferroelectrics and effective Hamiltonians of functional materials, reactive and photochemical dynamics, high-entropy and compositionally disordered materials, as well as generative and autonomous material discovery pipelines. Drawing on a growing body of critical, methodologically self-aware literature, we also show that this achievement carries systematic caveats. Uncertainty estimates are not interchangeable across model architectures and are frequently the least reliable exactly where they matter most. We close by discussing the outlook for standardized, uncertainty-calibrated, and observable-targeted active-learning workflows in the foundation-model era.

AI.tldr: 综述70余篇（重点2020–2026）文献，系统梳理主动学习（AL）如何从query-by-committee/高斯过程的on-the-fly训练演化为多样化的数据高效策略，并强调其不确定性估计的系统性隐患与标准化前景。
AI.motivation: MLIP应针对实际应用条件而非开发者预设构型保持准确，这是原子模拟的核心难题；AL通过打通"候选生成–数据筛选–参考计算–模型更新"闭环来应对，但该领域近年来快速分化、缺乏统一梳理与批判性审视。
AI.method: 文献综述法，覆盖70余项研究，按方法类型（on-the-fly MD、预训练模型微调的主动数据选择、基于冻结预训练模型的核/表示采集、面向非平衡化学体系的反应感知采样）与应用领域（元素与合金力学、氢与离子扩散、铁电与有效哈密顿量、反应与光化学动力学、高熵与成分无序材料、生成式/自主发现流程）两个维度归纳。
AI.result: AL已从细分技巧发展为数据高效策略家族，广泛渗透到力学、扩散、功能材料与自主发现等多类场景；但批判性文献表明不确定性估计在不同模型架构间不可互换，且恰在最关键区域最不可靠，构成系统性caveat。
AI.conclusion: 提出面向基础模型时代的展望：需建立标准化、不确定性校准、以可观测量为目标的AL工作流，方能保证MLIP在真实应用条件下的可靠性。

title: Low-Cost Third-order Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction Method for Excited States Using Tensor Hypercontraction and State-Specific Frozen Natural Orbitals
summary: We have developed a reduced-cost framework for excited-state calculations by combining the state-specific frozen natural orbital (SS-FNO) approach with the third-order algebraic diagrammatic construction [ADC(3)] method and tensor hypercontraction (THC). This strategy enables a systematic and controllable truncation of the virtual orbital space, while significantly lowering the computational scaling through the THC representation of the electron repulsion integrals. The method allows black-box application via adjustable thresholds and includes a perturbative correction that compensates for the truncation error. We have used the CIS(D) method to generate the natural orbitals for the excited states. The performance of the SS-FNO-THC-ADC(3) method is assessed for valence, Rydberg, and charge-transfer excitations. Benchmark calculations demonstrate that the combined approach achieves excellent agreement with the canonical ADC(3) results. The efficiency of the present implementation is demonstrated by calculating the excitation energy of a molecule containing 31 atoms and more than one thousand basis functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将态特异性冻结自然轨道(SS-FNO)、三阶代数图解构造[ADC(3)]与张量超收缩(THC)结合的降成本激发态计算框架，实现虚拟轨道空间的可控截断并显著降低计算标度。
AI.motivation: ADC(3)精度高但计算成本大，尤其虚拟轨道空间和大基组导致标度过高，亟需在保持精度的前提下系统性降低激发态计算成本。
AI.method: 用CIS(D)生成激发态自然轨道实现SS-FNO虚拟空间截断；以THC表示电子排斥积分降低标度；引入可调阈值实现黑箱式使用，并加入微扰修正补偿截断误差。
AI.result: 在价态、Rydberg和电荷转移激发上，SS-FNO-THC-ADC(3)与标准ADC(3)结果高度一致；成功计算了含31个原子、超过1000个基函数的分子激发能，验证了效率。
AI.conclusion: 该组合策略在保持ADC(3)精度的同时显著降低计算成本，具备黑箱可用性与可扩展性，适用于大体系激发态计算。

title: Permutationally Invariant Polynomial Descriptors as Colored Multigraphs
summary: The combinatorial explosion in monomial counts limits the extension of global permutationally invariant polynomial (PIP) potential energy surfaces to larger molecular systems. We use graph-theoretic language to reformulate PIPs as colored multigraphs and develop a series of theoretical and computational tools. First, we introduce an offline PIP generation algorithm whose cost has an upper bound independent of atom count for a fixed degree cutoff and number of element types. Second, we introduce a new online PIP evaluation algorithm, termed tensor-network descent. For the full PIP set through degree $d$ in a system of $M$ atoms, the evaluation complexity for $1\le d\le14$ is $O\!\left(f(d)M^{\left\lfloor(\sqrt{1+8d}+1)/2\right\rfloor}\right)$. At the commonly used cutoff of $d=5$, the online evaluation complexity decreases from the $M^{10}$ scaling of conventional explicit term-by-term computation to $M^3$. Numerical tests using the full PIP set through degree 5 show that our method achieves speedups of several orders of magnitude on most MD17 systems and remains computationally affordable for systems containing more than one thousand atoms. The method has a native tensor form, supports automatic differentiation, and provides a unified theoretical construction of four classes of PIP descriptors defined consistently across systems---global, atom-centered, bond-centered, and cluster-centered---establishing a representation and computational foundation for PIP potentials for large systems and for transfer across systems. Together, these results show that PIPs are neither inherently restricted to small systems nor intrinsically nontransferable.

AI.tldr: 该文将置换不变多项式（PIP）重构为彩色多重图，提出离线生成与在线"张量网络下降"求值算法，把度数5下的求值复杂度从 M^10 降至 M^3，使PIP势能面可扩展到上千原子体系。
AI.motivation: 全局置换不变多项式（PIP）势能面因单单项式数量组合爆炸，难以扩展到更大分子体系，通常被认为只适用于小体系且不可迁移。
AI.method: 用图论语言把PIP表述为彩色多重图，并开发两类工具：(1) 离线PIP生成算法，在固定度数截断与元素类型数下，代价上界与原子数无关；(2) 在线求值算法"张量网络下降"（tensor-network descent），具有天然张量形式并支持自动微分；同时统一构造全局、原子中心、键中心、团簇中心四类PIP描述符。
AI.result: 对1≤d≤14的全PIP集合，求值复杂度为 O(f(d)M^{⌊(√(1+8d)+1)/2⌋})；d=5 时由 M^10 降至 M^3。MD17多数体系上取得数个数量级加速，并可处理超过1000个原子的体系。
AI.conclusion: PIP并非本质上局限于小体系，也并非固有地不可迁移；该工作为大规模体系及跨体系迁移的PIP势提供了表示与计算基础。

title: Single-electron fluorine bonding. II. Benchmarking Minnesota density functional approximations and popular ab initio methods for binding energies (BEs) and F-bond distances
comment: 35 pages, main text (9 figures and 12 tables) and 28 pages Supporting Information (13 figures and 13 tables)
summary: Companion paper I (Khanal and Arunan, in this issue; arXiv:2610.16629 [physics.chem-ph]) reported reference BEs and F-bond distances for two new databases SEFB-15 (DF$\cdots$CH$_3$) and CSFB-14 (DF$\cdots$NH$_3$). Here, we assess performance of popular ab initio methods (MP2, MP3, MP4(DQ), MP4(SDQ), CCSD, and QCISD) with valence- and full-electron correlation treatments, and sixteen Minnesota DFAs, including M06-2X already assessed in companion paper I. CCSD/AVDZ reproduces reference F-bond distances closely, although BEs predicted by it deviate more. Among the 16 Minnesota DFAs, M08-HX reliably reproduces both reference values for DF$\cdots$CH$_3$ and DF$\cdots$NH$_3$, comparable to M05-2X and M06-2X for DF$\cdots$NH$_3$. Selected meta-GGAs (M06-L, M11-L, and MN15-L) exhibit spurious fractional charge transfer in cationic complexes even at infinite separation, whereas hybrid Minnesota DFAs do not, except M05 and M06 for NH$_3$F$^+\cdots$CH$_3$ and NH$_2$F$_2^+\cdots$CH$_3$. Although M08-HX shows slightly larger monomer delocalization error than M05-2X and M06-2X, it is more reliable for predicting BEs of SEFB complexes, indicating that monomer delocalization error alone does not govern DFA performance. Bader's intermolecular delocalization indices (DIs) further support M08-HX as more reliable than M05-2X and M06-2X for SEFB, while the larger DIs from M05-2X and M06-2X explain the degraded performance of their dispersion-corrected variants for DF$\cdots$CH$_3$, with only a minor impact for DF$\cdots$NH$_3$, highlighting the system-dependent nature of functional delocalization error. Present work reveals that M08-HX is more reliable than M05-2X and M06-2X for open-shell DF$\cdots$CH$_3$ complexes, while all three functionals show comparable reliability for closed-shell DF$\cdots$NH$_3$ complexes.

AI.tldr: 本文评估多种从头算方法与16种Minnesota密度泛函对DF⋯CH₃和DF⋯NH₃两类F-键体系的结合能与键长预测精度，发现M08-HX在开壳层DF⋯CH₃上比M05-2X/M06-2X更可靠，而三者对闭壳层DF⋯NH₃相当。
AI.motivation: 伴随论文I给出了SEFB-15（DF⋯CH₃）与CSFB-14（DF⋯NH₃）两个数据库的参考结合能和F-键距离，但哪些量子化学方法/密度泛函能可靠重现这些基准尚不清楚，尤其缺乏对开/闭壳层体系差异及泛函离域误差来源的系统认识。
AI.method: 测试MP2、MP3、MP4(DQ)、MP4(SDQ)、CCSD、QCISD在价电子与全电子关联下的表现，以及16种Minnesota密度泛函（含M06-2X），结合Bader分子间离域指数(DI)、单体检离域误差分析，比较结合能与F-键距离。
AI.result: CCSD/AVDZ能很好重现参考F-键距离，但结合能偏差较大；M08-HX对两类体系均能可靠重现参考值，与M05-2X、M06-2X在DF⋯NH₃上相当；选定的meta-GGA（M06-L、M11-L、MN15-L）在阳离子复合物中即使无限分离也出现虚假分数电荷转移，而杂化泛函（除M05、M06在特定体系外）无此问题；M08-HX单体检离域误差略大却更可靠，说明单体离域误差并非决定泛函表现的唯一因素；M05-2X/M06-2X较大的DI解释了其色散校正变体在DF⋯CH₃上的性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 泛函离域误差具有体系依赖性：M08-HX对开壳层DF⋯CH₃复合物比M05-2X、M06-2X更可靠，而对闭壳层DF⋯NH₃三者可靠性相当。

title: Vibro-polaritonic Raman spectroscopy via cavity Born-Oppenheimer perturbation theory
summary: We derive a vibro-polaritonic Raman activity from third-order cavity Born-Oppenheimer perturbation theory (CBO-PT) accounting for weak interactions between electrons and low-frequency cavity modes in the vibrational strong coupling (VSC) regime. This work extends the recently presented CBO-PT linear response approach [J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 2024, 15, 2262-2269] from infrared (IR) to vibro-polaritonic Raman spectroscopy. In a first step, we discuss cavity-induced corrections to the static dipole polarizability tensor, which manifest as molecular and cavity mode contribution determined by the polarization-projected static hyperpolarizability tensor. We then obtain the corresponding vibro-polaritonic Raman activity in double harmonic approximation, which contains molecular, cavity and mixed contributions similar to previously discussed CBO-PT IR intensities. The cavity Raman activity can be interpreted as effective transmission component, which is exclusively determined by the polaritonic Raman response. The methodology and its relation to vibro-polaritonic IR spectroscopy is illustrated for a formaldehyde molecule under VSC. An implementation of the CBO-PT linear response approach for vibro-polaritonic Raman and IR spectroscopies is provided via the open-source Python package CBOvibSpec.

AI.tldr: 基于三阶腔玻恩-奥本海默微扰理论(CBO-PT)，推导了振动强耦合(VSC)区弱电子-低频腔模相互作用下的振动极化激元拉曼活性，将CBO-PT线性响应方法从红外扩展到拉曼光谱，并以甲醛为对象进行了示例计算，附带开源实现CBOvibSpec。
AI.motivation: 此前提出的CBO-PT线性响应方法仅覆盖红外(IR)强度，缺乏对振动极化激元拉曼光谱的描述；需要一套统一框架来刻画VSC下腔诱导的极化率与拉曼活性，并与IR光谱建立对应关系。
AI.method: 采用含弱电子-低频腔模相互作用的三阶腔玻恩-奥本海默微扰理论(CBO-PT)：先讨论腔对静态偶极极化率张量的修正（由极化投影的静态超极化率张量决定，分为分子与腔模贡献），再在双谐振近似下得到含分子、腔及混合贡献的振动极化激元拉曼活性；腔拉曼活性可解释为仅由极化激元拉曼响应决定的有效透射分量。
AI.result: 推导出振动极化激元拉曼活性表达式，其结构与CBO-PT红外强度类似，包含分子、腔和混合三类贡献；腔诱导的静态极化率修正可分解为分子与腔模两部分；以VSC下的甲醛分子为例展示了方法及其与红外光谱的关系。
AI.conclusion: 将CBO-PT线性响应方法系统性扩展至振动极化激元拉曼光谱，给出可直接用于计算的拉曼活性公式及与IR光谱的对应关系，并通过开源Python包CBOvibSpec提供IR与拉曼光谱的实现。

title: Geometry-Dependent Electronic Coupling and Singlet Fission Pathways in Carotenoid Dimers
summary: Using the density matrix renormalization group method, we solve the Pariser--Parr--Pople model of $π$-electron systems to determine the character and energies of the low-lying eigenstates of a lycopene dimer comprising two 22-carbon-atom chains. To complement these calculations, we use the molecular-exciton, valence-bond model of polyene systems to derive selection rules governing interchain coupling, which provide a physical framework for interpreting the DMRG results. We find that dimer geometry strongly influences both the character and energetics of the low-lying eigenstates. In vertically stacked dimers, neither the bright-dimer state nor the triplet-pair states contain any interchain charge-transfer (CT) character. In contrast, in slip-stacked dimers, both the bright-dimer state and triplet-pair states do contain interchain CT character. We also find that increasing the interchain coupling preferentially stabilizes states with greater interchain character, leading to a reordering of the low-lying eigenstates. These results have direct implications for energetically possible singlet fission (SF) mechanisms in carotenoid aggregates. For vertically stacked dimers, the only energetically viable pathway identified here proceeds through intermediate intrachain triplet-pair states, whereas slip-stacked geometries allow an additional SF pathway mediated by interchain CT states. Our results establish a direct connection between carotenoid packing geometry, symmetry-controlled electronic coupling, and the energetically accessible pathways for SF.

AI.tldr: 用 DMRG 求解 22+22 碳番茄红素二聚体的 PPP 模型，揭示堆叠几何如何决定低激发态性质及单裂变路径。
AI.motivation: 类胡萝卜素聚集体中单裂变（SF）的能量可行路径依赖二聚体堆积几何与对称性控制的电子耦合，但缺乏定量关联。
AI.method: 密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）求解 π 电子 PPP 模型；辅以分子激子—价键模型推导链间耦合的选择定则，为 DMRG 结果提供物理解释框架。
AI.result: 垂直堆叠二聚体中，亮二聚体态与三重态对态均不含链间电荷转移（CT）成分；滑移堆叠二聚体中两者均含 CT 成分。增强链间耦合优先稳定链间成分更大的态，导致低激发态重排。
AI.conclusion: 垂直堆叠仅经链内三重态对中间态实现 SF；滑移堆叠还允许经链间 CT 态的额外 SF 通道，建立了堆积几何—对称性控制耦合—SF 可行路径的直接联系。

title: Physics-Transfer Learning: A Physics-Constrained Theory for Zero-Shot Generalization Along the Ladder of Complexity
summary: Reliable out-of-distribution generalization remains a central challenge in machine learning, particularly when models are deployed in data-scarce high-fidelity domains. Existing approaches often rely on statistical distribution alignment, or invariance assumptions that can fail when domain shifts reflect changes in underlying mechanisms. Inspired by a longstanding paradigm in physics that understands complex systems by starting from tractable idealizations and progressively incorporating additional mechanisms and levels of fidelity, we propose physics-transfer (PT) learning, a physics-constrained learning theory for zero-shot generalization along a ladder of complexity. PT constructs chains of anchor domains (CADs) that connect low-cost source domains to complex targets and introduces computable feasibility and reliability indicators for assessing transfer before target-domain labels are observed. Under physical-consistency and stable-representation assumptions, we derive an operational upper bound on target risk in terms of source empirical risk, the PT indicators, and finite-sample errors, and establish convergence as adjacent complexity gaps shrink and data coverage improves. We evaluate PT on excited-state energy prediction in quantum systems and dynamical-transition prediction in classical systems using neural networks trained without target-domain labels. Across substantial distribution shifts, PT yields accurate high-fidelity predictions, while the indicators identify incorrect physical mappings before target-domain prediction fails. These results provide a model-agnostic framework for designing, diagnosing, and controlling generalization in data-scarce learning problems.

AI.tldr: 提出“物理迁移学习”(PT)——一种面向复杂度阶梯上零样本泛化的物理约束学习理论，通过构建连接廉价源域与复杂目标域的“锚定域链”(CADs)，并给出可在未观测目标标签前评估迁移可行性与可靠性的指标。
AI.motivation: 在数据稀缺的高保真领域部署模型时，可靠的分布外泛化仍是机器学习核心难题；现有方法依赖统计分布对齐或不变性假设，当域偏移源于底层机制变化时会失效。受物理学“从可处理理想化出发、逐步纳入更多机制与保真度”的长期范式启发。
AI.method: 构建锚定域链（CADs）将低成本源域与复杂目标域相连；引入可计算的可行性/可靠性指标，在未观测目标标签前评估迁移；在物理一致性与稳定表示假设下推导目标风险的可操作上界（由源经验风险、PT指标与有限样本误差构成），并分析相邻复杂度间隙缩小与数据覆盖提升时的收敛性；在量子体系激发态能量预测与经典体系动力学跃迁预测上用神经网络进行无目标标签训练验证。
AI.result: 在显著分布偏移下，PT能给出准确的高保真预测；且当目标域预测将要失败时，指标能在其失败之前识别出错误的物理映射。
AI.conclusion: PT提供了一个模型无关的框架，用于数据稀缺学习问题中泛化能力的设计、诊断与控制。

title: Regime-Aware Coupled Orchestration of Neural Operator Specialists for Multiphysics Dynamics
summary: Real-world physics often unfolds over a variety of characteristic lengths and time scales. These non-uniformities are among the main reasons numerical simulations remain expensive when used predictively on practical systems: the same computational domain can contain smooth transport, vortical structures, thin interfaces, reaction fronts, and rapidly relaxing regions. Neural operators are attractive surrogates for such problems. However, a single architecture is still expected to represent all these local behaviours with a single set of weights and a single inductive bias. In this work, we introduce the regime-aware coupled neural orchestrator (RCNO), a framework that learns to distribute and connect a library of local operator specialists in space and time. For every patch, an orchestrator builds a causal query from the current fields, neighbouring halo values, local regime features, patch identity, activity level, and case parameters. The nine expert embeddings exchange two rounds of query-conditioned message passing before an edge-biased cross-attention stage produces a dispatch distribution that can be evaluated sparsely. Local predictions are assembled into a global field and projected onto system-specific physical constraints. A seam-aware extension additionally learns residual corrections across internal patch interfaces. We apply the same orchestration architecture to two qualitatively different systems: reacting flow and Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes (CHNS) dynamics. The results show that useful operator specialisation exists across local regimes, that the advantage of conditional composition increases as the spatial decomposition becomes finer, and, on reacting flow, that explicitly treating patch interfaces improves continuity, PDE consistency, and rollout accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出RCNO框架，用"编排器"在时空中调度一组局部算子专家，以适应多尺度非均匀物理场，并在反应流与CHNS两类系统上验证了条件组合与接缝修正的收益。
AI.motivation: 真实物理系统存在多种特征尺度与时间尺度（光滑输运、涡结构、薄界面、反应前沿等），单一神经网络算子被迫用一套权重和单一归纳偏置去覆盖所有局部行为，导致预测性数值模拟代价高昂、精度受限。
AI.method: RCNO由专家库+编排器构成：对每个patch，编排器基于当前场、邻居halo值、局部regime特征、patch身份、活跃度与算例参数构建因果query；9个专家嵌入经两轮query条件消息传递，再用边偏置交叉注意力生成可稀疏评估的调度分布；局部预测拼装为全局场并投影到系统特定物理约束；另有seam-aware扩展学习patch内部接口处的残差修正。
AI.result: 在反应流与Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes两种性质迥异的系统上，同一编排架构均有效：证实局部regime间存在有用的算子专门化；空间分解越细，条件组合的优势越明显；在反应流中显式处理patch接口可提升连续性、PDE一致性与长时rollout精度。
AI.conclusion: 以"专家库+条件编排"替代单一算子是应对多尺度非均匀物理的有效范式，且收益随分解粒度增强；接口/接缝建模对保证物理一致性不可忽视，该框架具备跨系统通用性。

title: Development of a Particle Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook Method for Rarefied Monatomic Gas Mixtures
summary: The Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) method has long served as a reliable numerical approach for simulating rarefied and non-equilibrium gas flows. Its computational cost, however, increases rapidly as the flow approaches the near-continuum regime. This limitation has motivated the development of kinetic model equations that replace binary collisions with simplified relaxation processes. This paper presents a particle multi-relaxation unified BGK (UBGK) model for monatomic gas mixtures. The model retains pairwise species relaxation and determines the target velocity, temperature, shear stress, and heat flux by matching the corresponding production terms to those of the Boltzmann equation. A stochastic particle algorithm is developed. The model is implemented in SPARTA, and two validation problems are considered: homogeneous relaxation and a Mach 3 flow over a cylinder. In both cases, the UBGK solution reproduces the DSMC reference behavior, including species-dependent relaxation and non-equilibrium shock structure.

AI.tldr: 该文提出粒子多松弛统一BGK(UBGK)模型用于单原子气体混合物,通过匹配Boltzmann方程产生项确定目标速度、温度、剪切应力和热流,并开发随机粒子算法实现于SPARTA,验证结果与DSMC一致。
AI.motivation: DSMC方法在近连续介质区计算成本急剧增加,需要用以简化松弛过程替代二体碰撞的动理学模型方程来降低计算代价。
AI.method: 构建保留配对组分松弛的多松弛UBGK粒子模型,将速度、温度、剪切应力、热流等目标量通过与Boltzmann方程相应产生项匹配来确定;开发随机粒子算法并在SPARTA中实现。
AI.result: 在均匀松弛和绕圆柱Mach 3流动两个验证算例中,UBGK解均再现了DSMC参考结果,包括组分相关的松弛行为和非平衡激波结构。
AI.conclusion: UBGK模型可在保持DSMC精度的同时降低近连续区计算成本,适用于单原子气体混合物的稀薄非平衡流动模拟。

title: Advanced computational methods for simulating the classical hydrogen atom in stochastic electrodynamics
summary: Stochastic electrodynamics (SED) is a theory of nature that seeks to derive key aspects of quantum mechanics and quantum electrodynamics from a purely classical physics perspective. While SED has been successful in many areas, it has largely failed to stably simulate the 3D classical hydrogen atom. The computational methodology presented here overcomes these foundational challenges. We develop a pseudo-wave formulation that integrates the solid angle in k-space utilizing symmetry, resulting in a significantly reduced memory footprint and lower computational overhead for generating the zero-point radiation spectrum. This optimization is paired with a logarithmic frequency grid, a sliding window tracking the instantaneous Keplerian frequency, and a Tukey smoothing function to eliminate discrete force discontinuities. Integrated via an adaptive RKF45 solver across highly dense grids of up to 100-million bins, these techniques demonstrate the asymptotic convergence of ensemble stability. We show that increasing the grid resolution in the high-frequency domain systematically mitigates artificial electron decay, yielding a simulated probability density function that closely aligns with the quantum mechanical ground state P(r).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套伪波公式与数值优化方法，使随机电动力学（SED）能够稳定模拟三维经典氢原子，并获得与量子力学基态一致的概率密度分布。
AI.motivation: SED 试图用纯经典视角推导量子力学与量子电动力学，但长期无法稳定模拟三维经典氢原子，计算成本与稳定性是根本障碍。
AI.method: 利用对称性在 k 空间积分掉立体角，构建伪波公式以大幅降低零点辐射谱生成的内存与计算开销；配合对数频率网格、跟踪瞬时开普勒频率的滑动窗口、Tukey 平滑函数消除离散力不连续；采用自适应 RKF45 求解器，网格多达 1 亿个 bin。
AI.result: 展示系综稳定性的渐近收敛；提高高频域网格分辨率可系统性抑制人为电子衰变，模拟得到的概率密度函数与量子力学基态 P(r) 高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该计算框架克服了 SED 模拟三维氢原子的基础性挑战，为经典视角下重现量子行为提供了可行的数值路径。

title: An Adaptive-Horizon Graph Neural Operator for coupled surrogate morphodynamic modelling
